scenes.text: Watch and read: While at the market, Ama thinks about this: Your paragraph repeats one idea three times. What revision helps?
The answer is: Remove repetition and add a relevant detail. Revision improves the ideas and flow.
Watch and read: Kojo is learning with a partner at school. Which change improves an unclear story?
The answer is: Explain why the character acted. Revising adds useful information.
